items.title: Verizon Just Gained 11% in a Month: “Only One Year Into a Multi-Year Growth Story”
items.summary: Key TakeawaysVerizon stock is up 11% in the past month, winning back its October selloff after SpaceX agreed to buy nationwide wireless spectrum. Verizon added 406,000 postpaid phones in the third quarter, its best third quarter in five years, and raised guidance for the third straight quarter, though revenue missed as equipment sales fell.
